description: This file defines the EmailTemplateParser class, which is responsible for parsing variables within email templates in the SuiteCRM project. It handles variable substitution based on template data, modules, and survey links, facilitating dynamic email content generation.

classes.name: EmailTemplateParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing variables within email templates, replacing placeholders with actual data from the associated module, survey, and campaign.

methods.name: parseVariables
methods.description: Parses and replaces variables in the email template's subject, body_html, and body fields, returning an array with parsed content.

methods.name: getParsedValue
methods.description: Replaces variable placeholders in a string with their corresponding values obtained via getValueFromBean method.

methods.name: getValueFromBean
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a variable from the module object or special variables like survey links, handling formatting and localization.

methods.name: getSurvey
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the associated Survey bean.

methods.name: getNonDBVariableValue
methods.description: Provides static or computed values for specific non-database variables such as survey URLs.
